# side-piece

> A convenience skill wrapper around ai-cli-mcp. It pins that server, installs it into
> Claude Code, Codex, and opencode, and ships a skill that routes resumable
> external-model work — reviews, delegated implementation, second opinions — to a
> model other than the one running.

## Install it

    npm install --save-dev @tjw.dev/side-piece

Then read `node_modules/@tjw.dev/side-piece/README.md` and follow it.

That file is the install contract. It ships inside the tarball so you have it on disk,
and it is authoritative over anything written here.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/README.md): the install contract
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/skill/side-piece/SKILL.md): routing, shorthand resolution, effort rules
- [lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/skill/side-piece/references/lifecycle.md): PIDs, sessions, resume, run state
- [model catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/skill/side-piece/references/model-catalog.md): reading the catalog response
- [Repository](https://github.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece)
- [ai-cli-mcp](https://github.com/mkXultra/ai-cli-mcp): the pinned server, by mkXultra
